text:
Jordan L: Hi all 00just started this week (Germany-based). Couple of onboarding questions: 1) my prepaid stipend card hasn't activated yet 00who do I ask? 2) my first net pay looks much lower than expected00SEPA transfer shows pending/failed? 3) can I enroll in the dental add-on retroactively (started mid-month)? I uploaded passport + visa appointment receipt as `jord_passport.pdf` and `jord_visa_receipt.jpg`. Thanks!

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Jordan! Congrats. For the card ping people-ops-cards but I can also escalate. Card activation sometimes delays for EU hires due to address verification. What error do you see when you try to activate?

Jordan L: On the card site it says "activation pending verification" and I didn't get a SMS code. Address is correct.

Ben - Payroll: Hey Jordan 00welcome. SEPA failures usually come from missing IBAN format or BIC mismatch. Can you DM me the payment screenshot (no full account numbers) and the sort code equivalent? Also first pay runs can be prorated if you started after the payroll cutoff 00what's your start date?

Jordan L: Start date was Mar 22. The paystub line shows "prorated salary" and a low tax refund I don't understand.

Rina (Benefits): Hi Jordan 00you can elect dental within 30 days; retro to start date depends on payroll cutoffs. If payroll hasn't closed for the month we can make it retroactive, otherwise it will begin next month. If you want dental now, put the election form in Workday and tag me.

Maya (People Ops): For the SMS code I'll check with the card vendor. Also check that your phone number in Workday has country code +49. If it's missing, that often blocks SMS. I'll update it now.

Ben - Payroll: FYI we paid out a partial gross for the first pay because the monthly payroll cutoff was Mar 20. Since you started Mar 22 your full month wasn't included. We did initiate a SEPA retry this morning; bank replied "invalid BIC". Jordan please DM the exact IBAN/BIC shown on your bank portal. If you need cash sooner, submit an expense via Expensify with policy `newhire-advance` and tag payroll.

Jordan L: Sent DM with screenshot. Also I have a visa expedite fee receipt 00can that be reimbursed under relocation? It was a required appointment to get docs done before start.

Maya (People Ops): Submit that under Expensify with category `relocation` and add notes "visa expedite - required for start". We'll review; typically travel and mandatory visa fees are eligible but please include proof of payment and the appointment confirmation.

Rina (Benefits): If you elect dental and want coverage from your start date, note that premiums will be collected starting next payroll; payroll will backfill the company's portion if eligible. I'll watch your Workday entry and flag if we can backdate.

Ben - Payroll: Quick note on taxes: Germany hires get local tax tables applied. The W-4 is for US employees only; ignore for DE. We sent you the DE withholding checklist by email. If the tax amount looks wrong DM me the paystub and I'll run numbers.

Jordan L: Got it, thx. One more tiny thing: public holidays pro-rated? I have Easter week starting in my first month.

Maya (People Ops): Yes we apply DE public holidays pro-rata for the calendar month. I'll compute your remaining holiday entitlement and post the numbers in Workday comments EOD.

Ben - Payroll: SEPA retry confirmed queued. Expect payment in 1-2 business days after bank accepts. If it fails again we'll do an off-cycle euro payment.

Jordan L: Appreciate it all 00thanks for the quick help :clap:
